definitions.mae_all_rep_mean_fixed_diagnostic: MAE of the above fixed mean; labels are used only for evaluation, never to select a representation
definitions.max_abs_change: max_j |pred_j - pred_orig| over legal representations j, 0 if n_reps=1
definitions.mean_abs_change_alt: mean |pred_j - pred_orig| over alternative representations only
definitions.mean_all: mean prediction over all legal representations including the original (fixed-model diagnostic, not a score)
definitions.range: max_j pred_j - min_j pred_j over legal representations

inputs.checkpoints: P3B seed0 (xBssl_P3N_s0) and T seed1 (SF_T_s1), fixed
